name: resizable-navbar

frames.best_why: The navbar is settled into its narrow floating pill at the top, showing the scrolled state clearly.

tagline: A nav bar that shrinks into a floating rounded pill as you scroll.
summary: A top navigation that starts full width and, once the page scrolls, contracts into a narrow blurred capsule holding the logo, links and buttons close together.
appearance: A dark site header with a small logo and wordmark at the left, four grey links centred and two buttons at the right. Scrolled, the same row narrows into a rounded dark pill with a soft shadow.
behaviour: After about a hundred pixels of scroll the bar springs inward to forty percent width, drops slightly and gains blur plus a shadow; returning to the top expands it back. Hovering a link slides a grey pill behind it.
demo_content: Brand 'Startup', links Features, Pricing, About, Blog, and a page headed 'Plan, build and ship in one place'.
search_phrases: top nav with blur when scrolling
site header that becomes a capsule
collapsing header for a saas site
use_when: A marketing page wants a full-width top bar at rest that stays out of the way while reading.
avoid_when: The desktop bar keeps a hard 800px minimum width, so it crowds tablets and needs the separate mobile parts.
customise: Compose Navbar, NavBody, NavItems and the mobile parts; link labels arrive as an items array, while width, blur, shadow and breakpoints are set in the source.
weight_why: A scroll listener drives a few spring properties on one or two bars.

a11y.note: The mobile toggle is a bare SVG icon with no label or button role, so the mobile menu cannot be opened by keyboard.

issues: Mid-transition the shrinking bar smears over the headline and briefly looks unresolved.
polish_why: Confident scroll shrink with a soft glass pill; the mid-scroll frame overlaps the headline.
